task: Section 7: Network simplification with circuit-informed surrogate SNN
conclusions: Hidden layer size can be reduced from 512 to 32 neurons while staying above 75% accuracy, provided the network keeps 28x28 resolution, 20 time steps, and 8-bit weights.
Time steps can be reduced from 20 to 10 while staying above 75% accuracy, but this requires at least 64 hidden neurons at 28x28 resolution.
Weight precision can be reduced to 2 bits and still remain above 75% accuracy when using 28x28 inputs, 64 hidden neurons, and 10 time steps.
Input resolution could not be reduced below 28x28 in this practical run while maintaining the 75% target.

recommended_report_configuration.reason: This is the smallest hidden-layer simplification that still clears the 75% target in the tested search.

alternate_configuration.reason: This version keeps accuracy higher while reducing both time steps and quantization more aggressively.
